notes: Native-green 19-assertion FOM transportation reference witness. Public Create accepts object-attribute and interaction-class transportation names declared in a later compatible module; joined lookup exposes the classes, attribute, and transportation type. Public Create rejects an unresolved transportation name, then permits valid federation-name reuse. Direct mappings are to clauses 4.11.2, 6.2.5, 6.2.6, clause 4, and Annex C. The public RTI API does not expose the class-to-transportation table inspected privately by the native case; runtime delivery and broader transportation merge semantics are separate work. Java provider runtime, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
